serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
As we get in the seats I notice just how many straps of different kinds there are to lock.
Someone from the staff comes up to me and starts locking all of them with great speed.
You: I guess there’s no turning back…
Staff member: Hello sir, please sign this.
You: W-What is this?
Staff member: Oh, that’s nothing! It’s standard these days!
You: There wasn’t anything to sign on a ferris wheel…
Staff: It’s just to make sure you won’t sue us for damages! 
You: W-What?!
Staff member: Hey, John, we got a struggler! 
You: H-Hey! What are you doing! {{punch}}
As I was screaming, two men forced my hand to sign the 20 pages long document…
You: Was that really necessary?!
Bot: How exciting! They really know how to hype up the ride!
You: I don’t think that was their goal…
Staff member: Listen up! Do not touch the buckles during the ride! Grab the steel bar in front of you with all you have! Your head needs to be firmly placed into the seat! That’s all. Ride is starting!
???: Wait a minute! It says on the display panel that one seat has a belt malfunction!
Staff member: I already started the-
I didn’t hear the rest as we started to spin with tremendous speed…
Fuck!
For someone that seems a little overprotective why did {f_botName} choose this ride!
???: I don’t want to die!
That’s what I heard from the back seats…
When will this ride end?!
I try to look at {f_botName}’s face and I see… {{wi}}smile…
